items.title: Parasitic modules have vanishing cohomology
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: For a presheaf of modules on the big site of a scheme for one of five topologies, the lemma asserts that if the presheaf vanishes on the objects of the topology which are flat over the base then all its cohomology vanishes on those objects, and that a presheaf parasitic in the stronger sense has vanishing cohomology on every flat object (statement lines 4004-4019). The proof is carried out in the fppf case, the other cases being parallel. The hypothesis is unwound to say that the presheaf takes the value zero on every object flat and locally of finitely presented over the base, and then the Cech vanishing criterion is applied to the subset of the site consisting exactly of those objects and the collection of all coverings of its members (proof lines 4021-4028). The claim is H2: the proof is short, but it consists of exhibiting the precise input the cited vanishing criterion needs -- a subset of the site and a collection of coverings for it, with the hypothesis checked on that subset -- and that choice is the content of the argument rather than a restatement of the conclusion.
